_meta.nutrition_note: calories_kcal and protein_g are per-serving estimates

quick.name: Korean Bulgogi Beef Bowls
ingredients: marinade: soy, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, pear or apple grated, ginger
kimchi, fried egg, scallions to serve
steps: Start rice; marinate beef while it cooks.
Sear beef hot and fast in batches, 2 min.
Serve over rice with kimchi and a fried egg.

quick.name: Pad Krapow (Thai Basil Chicken)
ingredients: sauce: oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, dark soy, sugar splash
big bunch holy or Thai basil
steps: Start rice; fry eggs until lacy-crisp.
Stir-fry garlic/chili/shallot, add meat, brown hard.
Add sauce, toss off heat with basil; serve over rice with egg.

quick.name: Gyudon (Japanese Simmered Beef Bowl)
ingredients: simmer liquid: dashi or stock, soy, mirin, sake, sugar
short-grain rice, pickled ginger, raw or onsen egg
steps: Simmer onion in sauce liquid 5 min.
Add beef, simmer 3-4 min until just cooked.
Pile over rice, top with egg and ginger.

quick.name: Weeknight Butter Chicken
ingredients: tomato passata, garam masala, cumin, paprika, kasuri methi if you have it
steps: Start rice; marinate chicken while pan heats.
Char chicken in batches, remove.
Butter, sauté aromatics + spices, add passata, simmer 5 min.
Blend smooth if you want restaurant texture, return chicken, finish with cream.

quick.name: Chipotle-Style Chicken Burrito Bowls
ingredients: canned black beans, warmed with garlic
rice cooked with bay + lime zest
corn salsa, cheese, guac or avocado
steps: Start rice; season chicken hard.
Sear chicken 5-6 min per side, rest, slice.
Warm beans; assemble bowls with toppings.

quick.name: Shrimp Pad Thai
ingredients: sauce: tamarind paste, fish sauce, palm/brown sugar
bean sprouts, garlic chives, peanuts, lime
steps: Soak noodles in hot water while prepping.
Scramble eggs, sear shrimp, add noodles + sauce.
Toss 2-3 min, finish with sprouts, peanuts, lime.

quick.name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: sauce: soy, black vinegar, sugar, cornstarch
steps: Velvet chicken 10 min in soy/cornstarch; start rice.
Flash-fry chilies + peppercorns, sear chicken.
Add aromatics + sauce, glaze, toss peanuts and scallions.

quick.name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
ingredients: shawarma marinade: yogurt, cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, garlic, lemon
steps: Marinate chicken while oven heats to 220C/425F.
Roast chicken 18-20 min, start rice meanwhile.
Build bowls, drizzle tahini sauce.

quick.name: Skillet Steak Fajitas
ingredients: fajita spice: cumin, chili, smoked paprika, oregano
flour tortillas, cheese, sour cream, lime
steps: Sear whole steak 3-4 min per side, rest.
Char peppers and onions in same pan.
Slice steak against grain, serve sizzling with warm tortillas.

quick.name: Oyakodon (Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl)
steps: Simmer chicken + onion in seasoned dashi until cooked through.
Pour in eggs, cover 60-90 sec until barely set.
Slide over individual bowls of hot rice.

batch.name: Crockpot Chicken Tikka Masala
batch.reheat: Microwave or gentle simmer; add splash of cream after reheating; cook rice fresh
ingredients: yogurt + lemon + spices (marinade, even 15 min helps)
garam masala, cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, cayenne
2 cans crushed tomatoes, 200ml cream, butter knob
steps: Bloom spices with onion/garlic/ginger in butter on the stove 5 min.
Everything into crockpot except cream; low 5-6h.
Blend partially or fully, stir in cream + methi.
Freeze sauce+chicken flat; never freeze the rice.

batch.name: Dutch Oven Chicken Biryani
batch.reheat: Covered oven at 160C with splash of water, or microwave covered; texture is best day-of but freezes acceptably
ingredients: yogurt, biryani/masala spices, saffron bloomed in warm milk
fried onions (2 large), mint + cilantro, ghee
steps: Marinate chicken in spiced yogurt 30+ min.
Parboil rice 70% done.
Layer marinated chicken + rice + herbs + fried onions + saffron milk in pot.
Seal with foil + lid, bake 180C/350F for 35-40 min, rest 10 before opening.

batch.name: Carnitas (Crockpot Pulled Pork, Michoacán-style)
batch.reheat: Broil portions 5 min for crispy edges straight from fridge/frozen-thawed
ingredients: orange juice + lime, garlic, oregano, cumin, bay
serve as: tacos, burrito bowls, quesadillas, tortas
steps: Season pork, crockpot with citrus + aromatics, low 8h.
Shred, spread on sheet pans with fat, broil until edges crisp.
Portion with some cooking fat/juice to stay moist.

batch.name: Chicken Tinga
batch.reheat: Microwave; use in tacos, tostadas, burrito bowls, enchiladas
ingredients: 2-4 chipotles in adobo, 1 sliced onion, garlic
toppings: queso fresco, crema, avocado, rice, beans
steps: Optional: char onions + chipotles in a dry pan first for depth.
Everything in crockpot, low 6h; shred into the sauce.
Boost bowl calories with rice, cheese and crema.

batch.name: Chicken and Sausage Gumbo
batch.reheat: Stovetop over medium, stirring; serve over fresh rice
ingredients: 1kg chicken thighs, cubed; 600g andouille or smoked sausage
dark roux: 150g flour + 150g oil, cooked to chocolate color
holy trinity: onion, celery, green pepper + garlic
cajun seasoning, thyme, bay, filé powder to finish
steps: Brown sausage and chicken, reserve.
Make roux, stirring constantly 20-30 min to dark brown — don't walk away.
Wilt trinity into roux, add stock, meats, seasonings; simmer 1h.
Freeze WITHOUT rice; cook rice fresh per portion.

batch.name: Jambalaya
batch.reheat: Microwave with splash of water or stovetop covered pan
ingredients: 800g chicken thighs, diced; 500g andouille; 500g shrimp (add at end)
trinity: onion, celery, green pepper, garlic
cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, thyme, bay
steps: Brown meats, sauté trinity + spices.
Add tomatoes, stock, rice; cover and simmer 25-30 min undisturbed.
Fold in shrimp last 5 min. Freezes fine though rice softens slightly.

batch.name: Slow-Cooker Lamb Rogan Josh
batch.reheat: Stovetop or microwave; thickens when cold, loosen with water; cook rice fresh
ingredients: rogan josh paste: garlic, ginger, Kashmiri chili powder, paprika, fennel ground, dry-roasted ground cardamom + cloves
2 onions finely diced, yogurt 250g whisked in at end
tomato passata 400g, ghee or neutral oil for frying paste
bay leaves, black peppercorns, cinnamon stick
basmati rice or naan to serve
steps: Fry onions until deep golden, add garlic/ginger + spices, bloom into a dark paste.
Lamb + passata into crockpot with the paste; low 6-7h.
Stir whisked yogurt in during last 30 min so it doesn't split.
Freeze flat in portions; sauce improves after freezing.

batch.name: Beef Rendang
batch.reheat: Stovetop splash of coconut milk; flavor improves after freezing
ingredients: rendang paste: lemongrass, galangal or ginger, chilies, shallots, garlic, turmeric
2 cans coconut milk, makrut lime leaves, tamarind
toasted coconut flake garnish, rice to serve
steps: Blitz paste; fry in oil until fragrant and darkened, 10 min.
Add beef + coconut milk, bare simmer 2.5-3h until sauce reduces and coats the meat (not dry unless going full rendang).
Portion with rice separately; freezes exceptionally well.

batch.name: Filipino Chicken Adobo
batch.reheat: Microwave or simmer; tastes even better days later
ingredients: 1 cup soy sauce, 3/4 cup white vinegar, lots of garlic, bay leaves, whole peppercorns
steps: Dump everything in the pot, bring to simmer, cook covered 40 min.
Uncover, reduce sauce, optionally brown chicken at the end.
One of the easiest big batches that exists; sauce over rice is the point.

batch.name: Beef Pho (Slow Broth)
batch.reheat: Boil broth; assemble bowls fresh — noodles, raw-sliced beef, herbs never freeze
ingredients: charred onion + ginger, star anise, cinnamon, cloves, coriander seed
per bowl: thin rice noodles, eye-of-round shaved thin, bean sprouts, Thai basil, lime, chili, cilantro
steps: Blanch bones 10 min, rinse; char onion + ginger under broiler.
Simmer bones/spices 6-8h in crockpot (or 3-4h stovetop); strain, season with fish sauce + sugar.
Freeze broth in quart portions; boil broth and pour over raw-sliced beef + cooked noodles per serving.

batch.name: Massaman Beef Curry (Crockpot)
batch.reheat: Stovetop or microwave with splash of coconut milk; potatoes soften further when frozen but that's fine here
ingredients: massaman paste (store-bought fine) fried briefly in coconut cream
2 cans coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind
baby potatoes, roasted peanuts, cinnamon stick, cardamom
steps: Fry paste in thick coconut cream until split and fragrant.
All ingredients into crockpot, low 7-8h.
Adjust sweet/sour/salty at the end; serve over rice.

batch.name: Louisiana Red Beans and Rice
batch.reheat: Microwave or stovetop; thickens cold, add water; always fresh rice
ingredients: 600g andouille + a ham hock or pickled meat if you have it
trinity + garlic, bay, thyme, cayenne, smoked paprika
cook Monday, eat all week (it's tradition)
steps: Brown sausage, sweat trinity with spices.
Add beans, hock, water to cover; simmer 2.5-3h (or crockpot low 8h), smashing some beans against the pot to make it creamy.
Season late (hock is salty); serve over rice with hot sauce.
